annotations.text:
OPTION A — Structured sunlight (recommended)

Nav grows 72px → 34px signal strip + 88px bar. Wordmark 20→26px, links 14→15px, active rule 2.5→3px, and a real secondary action (Contact) beside the yellow CTA.

Hero earns its screen: 94px display type with a yellow slab under 'think back', and a live world panel on the right so the page finally SHOWS a world instead of only claiming one.

OPTION B — Flood sunlight (bolder)

Same nav mass, but the hero is a full yellow flood with 132px ink type and the nav sitting on the colour. A voxel skyline is cut off by the fold to pull the reader down.

Tradeoff: unmistakable and very on-brand, but it spends the yellow all at once — the accent has less punch further down the page, and body copy on yellow is a slightly harder read.

NAV — today vs proposed, stacked for comparison, plus the condensed 64px state after scroll. The current bar hides rather than condenses; condensing keeps navigation reachable without stealing hero height.
MOBILE — Option A at 390px. 48px menu target, 56px stacked CTAs. No fake status bar: the real one renders on top.
